title: Supreme Court directs States and UTs to frame policy for early release of terminally ill, elderly prisoners
description: The Supreme Court on Thursday directed all the States and Union Territories to formulate and notify a comprehensive policy within three months for early or premature release of prisoners who are of advanced age or are terminally ill.A Bench of Justices Vikram Nath and Sandeep Mehta said policy shall be framed in consultation with the respective State legal services authorities to ensure institutional coordination and effective identification of eligible prisoners.The Court issued the directions
